data.body:
Plan review 2026-10-28 returned BLOCK on 2 findings at origin/main e2ed08b343a. Both were verified against the tree before being accepted, and both were correct.

1. `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` — the plan named only the `:486` run-request row and the `:532` count. `grep -n _review_ticket_impl` returns THREE sites: `:117` (a live call), `:247` (the `_UNFOLLOWABLE` registry entry), `:486`. Confirmed the coupling the finding asserted: `test_neither_registry_has_stale_entries` at `:600` asserts `set(_UNFOLLOWABLE) <= by_verdict["unresolved"]`, so deleting the function while leaving the `:247` entry fails that test. All 4 sites are now enumerated in the description.

2. `tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py:181` — confirmed it carries `"prompt": "ticket-quality"`, and AC1's pathspec is `-- src tests docs scripts` with excludes only for `docs/release-notes.md`, `docs/adr`, `docs/experiments`, `tests/fixtures`. `tests/external` is in scope and unexcluded, so AC1 could not have passed. Now enumerated in the description rather than only in the first comment.

Also addressed: the compound acceptance criteria flagged by the P6 advisory are split, so each criterion is one independently checkable command (9 criteria, previously 6).

Not addressed, and why: the E6 advisory asks for the whole per-file test list to be inlined rather than referenced from the first comment. Inlining it measures 9,641 characters against the 8,000-character admission cap (`verify.max_ticket_description_chars`, not overridden in `rebar.toml`), so it cannot be satisfied as written without cutting the rationale the other criteria depend on. The two sites that actually block are inlined instead. The P4 oversize advisory (41 file-impact entries against a threshold of 30) is noted; the story is not split because the two halves would still exceed the cap individually and `aggregate.py` is a 125-line orphan whose separation buys nothing — it is referenced only from `spec_scan.py:13,137` and `__init__.py:36,106`, and the review engine does not reference it at all.

`file_impact` corrected alongside: added `src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py` (`:153`) and `src/rebar/llm/evals/provider_parity.py` (`:80`), which the plan edits but the impact set omitted; removed `tests/unit/workflow/test_prompt_refs.py`, `tests/external/test_llm_trace.py` and `tests/unit/test_code_review_gate_session.py`, all three verified to contain zero hits for any retired id on the tip, so they are no-ops rather than edits. Net 40 entries, and every entry's reason now carries its measured line numbers.
